links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of chatbot answers to genetic testing FAQs
links.effect: FKGL scores were higher than the average American reading level across all platforms (ChatGPT 3.5: 13.5, Gemini: 13.3, Reddit Answers: 12.1, Bootcamp: 14.6, DeepSeek: 14.2).
links.quote: The FKGL readability scores of answers across all AI platforms are consistently higher than the reading level of the average American (ChatGPT 3.5: 13.5, Google Gemini: 13.3, Reddit Answers: 12.1, Bootcamp: 14.6, DeepSeek: 14.2).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education answers relative to average American reading level
links.effect: Answers from all five chatbots had FKGL of 12.1-14.6, above the average American reading level.
links.quote: The FKGL readability scores of answers across all AI platforms are consistently higher than the reading level of the average American (ChatGPT 3.5: 13.5, Google Gemini: 13.3, Reddit Answers: 12.1, Bootcamp: 14.6, DeepSeek: 14.2).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of five AI chatbots answering 39 genetic testing FAQs, assessed for clinical accuracy and readability by expert clinicians and genetic counselors.
